entries.text: Lantern Haven drifts above the cloud sea, sheltering navigators who search for a missing survey crew.
The Tidemark Piers hold silent skiffs and a trail of blue signal glass.
The Menders' Loft offers quiet rest and practical field care.
The Signal Archive stores weather songs as rings of light.
Stormglass Spire gathers the false beacon that keeps the survey crew's skiff circling in the clouds.
You align the signal-glass fragments and reveal a route toward the archive.
You decode the weather-song and learn how to safely silence the false beacon.
A distant beacon pulse warns that the search window is narrowing.
The cloudway is calm.
A tethered emergency case contains a field patch kit.
A clockwork scrap warden blocks the cloudway and demands a harmless test of skill.
The clue is the useful discovery.
You return loose signal fittings to the Haven exchange for three credits.
Your careful strike glances away.
Your strike disrupts the warden's balance.
The warden's padded arm sweeps past.
The warden's padded arm knocks you off balance.
A closing safety rail blocks the exit for this turn.
You slip beyond the warden's marked practice ring.
The calmed warden opens its recovered-supplies locker.
The false beacon fades, and the missing survey crew guides its skiff home to Lantern Haven.
The beacon pattern resets; you can regroup and attempt the sequence again.
